# viettelcloud_elastic_ip (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud Elastic IP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "viettelcloud_elastic_ip" "example" {
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  region      = { name = "vn-central-1" }
  enable_ipv4 = true
  enable_ipv6 = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (Attributes) Project region where the Elastic IP is created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--region))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the Elastic IP. Omitting it preserves the backend value; set it to an empty string to clear it.
- `enable_ipv4` (Boolean) Enable IPv4. Defaults to true. Changing a configured value replaces the Elastic IP.
- `enable_ipv6` (Boolean) Enable IPv6. Defaults to false. Changing a configured value replaces the Elastic IP.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the Elastic IP was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Elastic IP ID (UUID).
- `ip_address` (String) The assigned IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_address` (String) The assigned IPv6 address.
- `status` (String) Current Elastic IP status.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the Elastic IP was last updated (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--region"></a>
### Nested Schema for `region`

Required:

- `name` (String) Region name.
